name: ui-ux
summary: Two floors the pack never had. (1) CHART ENCODING. The pack made a chart MATCH the design language — /redesign Phase 3 and ui-design-sweep normalize-surface both catch a library-default chart on an art-directed page — and checked nothing about whether it was the right chart. Grepping the whole repo returned `chart type` 0 files, `sequential palette` 0, `diverging palette` 0. A re-themed nine-slice pie with a truncated axis and a red-vs-green legend passed every gate in this pack. New ai-patterns/data-visualization.md carries the chart-selection map (question -> mark, with a Never column), the three data-colour scale families (data colour is NOT the UI accent ramp; categorical ceiling ~8; rainbow is never sequential), and eight encoding-honesty rules (bars start at zero, area encodes area not radius, one scale per axis, missing data drawn as missing). New chart-encoding-audit skill runs it, and prints NOT RUN as a real state so an omitted colour-vision check cannot read as a pass. Filed as a THIRD companion floor in axis-catalog.md, parallel to per-surface completeness — the closed 16 axes / 19 verbs counts are unchanged. (2) DIVERGENCE VOCABULARY. creative-director's check demands each pair of directions differ on >=2 of four structural axes, but the positions those axes can take existed only as parenthetical examples inside one table cell, so the regenerate loop kept drawing from an exhausted well and returned clean-modern-minimal in three tints. New ai-patterns/direction-vocabulary.md enumerates all four — 10 IA archetypes, 7 grid logics, 6 shape languages, 4 density registers + 7 signature interactions — each with the job it serves, its failure mode and where it does NOT fit. Deliberately structural and project-agnostic, never a style catalogue: a named position says how a screen is ORGANISED, so using one cannot produce the borrowed-skin diagnosis a style catalogue reliably does. Type, colour and motion are named explicitly as REGISTERS that do not count toward the >=2 requirement, which is what the colour-ramp-swap test already implied and no file said.
